text: @claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面插件，会把运行中固定显示的“Deep diving...”状态文字换成轮换的 Claude Code 风格提示词。它通过浏览器客户端模块扫描聊天状态区域，在 DOM 变化时以及定时扫描时替换匹配的文本节点，并保留状态行中的计时信息。提示词从内置词表随机选择，连续两次尽量不重复；插件也会在效果清理时停止观察器和定时器。适合希望自定义模型运行中状态文案的 DSH Web 用户；无需额外 API Key 或外部服务。

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin replaces the DSH web status text “Deep diving...” with random Claude Code-style loading words while a turn runs. It scans status elements after DOM changes and on a timer, preserving the elapsed-time display. No API key or external service is required.
DSH 运行时能把“Deep diving...”换成不断变化的提示词吗？
想让网页端的模型工作状态不再一直显示同一句话。
给 DSH Web 的等待状态加一些随机的工作中短语。
模型生成时，能不能显示轮换的状态文案并保留计时？
让聊天页面在状态文字变化后自动更新提示词。
How can I replace the static working status label in the DSH web UI?
I want varied loading words while a model turn is running.
Could the chat page update its working phrase automatically?
@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin 的功能「轮换运行状态」：在 DSH Web 的状态区域发现“Deep diving...”文本后，将其替换为随机的内置提示词；连续选择时避免重复上一次。
@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin 的功能「自动监测状态」：浏览器客户端监听页面 DOM 变化，并每隔四秒扫描状态区域；发现目标文字时自动更新，无需用户操作。
@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin 的功能「卸载效果清理」：客户端效果结束时断开 DOM 观察器并清除定时扫描器，避免遗留后台监测。

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · @claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin bundle for the web profile. It replaces the static **Deep diving...** turn-status label with randomly switching, Claude Code-style **loading words** — the original 56-word set — while a turn is running. The elapsed-time clock next to the status is preserved.

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · What it changes：Before:

```
Deep diving... 12s
```

After (randomly switches every few seconds):

```
Thinking...  12s
```

The implementation is a small browser-side client plugin: it watches the chat DOM and rewrites only the status text node. No server code, no model prompt changes, no fork of DSH.

The full 56-word list:

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · What it changes：```
Accomplishing, Actioning, Actualizing, Baking, Brewing, Calculating,
Cerebrating, Churning, Clauding, Coalescing, Cogitating, Computing,
Conjuring, Considering, Cooking, Crafting, Creating, Crunching,
Deliberating, Determining, Doing, Effecting, Finagling, Forging,

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · Install：Requires the `web` profile and a DSH version that supports out-of-tree bundles (`dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 or newer).

```sh

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · from this directory：dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Or install from a git checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:your-name/dsh-claude-code-tips
```

Then start the web UI:

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · Verify：1. Start the web UI and open a session.
2. Send a message.
3. While the model is working, the status line should show randomly switching loading words such as `Thinking...`, `Pondering...`, or `Musing...` instead of `Deep diving...`.

To disable without uninstalling, add to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: claude-code-tips
  disabled: true
```

@claude-code-tips/dsh-plugin README · Development：The plugin has no build step. `client.js` is the browser half loaded by DSH's client module system; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts it into the web profile.
